notes: Same read as the decorating prompt it repeats: furnishing a home interior sits with Roleplay & Avatar Sim, while the completion-gated repeatable placement loop is the genre's stated boundary into Simulation, so both are named and Simulation supplies the option that does the work. interior-single is the shape — one room, no exterior to generate and no transition to link — which is what keeps building-interior and its P3 off a build that would otherwise look like it needs them. Role Sim is taken from the secondary genre with world-open swapped for interior-single and path-road-vehicle dropped: trigger-task is the designated placement slots the answer confirmed as the completion condition, path-circulation is the standing room that keeps every slot reachable. The prompt bars clarifying questions outright, so everything was settled here — contemporary apartment dressing, one room, slots rather than freeform scoring — and the one call worth recording is that its emphatic 'not a 2D or UI game' makes this a walkable third-person P0 build, the opposite of the P5 the catalog menu might otherwise suggest.
